deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a heavily corrected pencil draft, in two successive attempts, of a covering letter. Riemann wrote it over a printed account-book form with columns headed No., Auslage, Porto, Franko. The upper attempt is largely struck through. The lower attempt is the fuller redraft.

Who the letter is addressed to: almost certainly the editor of Crelle's Journal, C. W. Borchardt, who edited it after Crelle's death in 1855. The next page closes the same letter with 'Euer Wohlgeboren für den Abdruck derselben ... Mit der vollkommensten Hochachtung verharre ich'. The opening formula should read roughly: 'Zu der Erklärung, daß Ew. Wohlgeboren die Mittheilung meiner Untersuchungen über Abel'sche Functionen durch das Crelle'sche Journal gestatten wollen ...'. I take the machine transcription's 'Herr Weissenborn' to be a misreading of the honorific '(Ew.) Wohlgeboren'.

Content in outline:
(1) Riemann thanks the editor for agreeing to publish his investigations on Abelian functions in Crelle's Journal.
(2) He explains that this led him to set out separately the auxiliary tools ('Hülfsmittel') for these investigations, which he had taken from his 1851 Göttingen dissertation. That dissertation had not appeared in Crelle's Journal.
(3) He says he has presented the topics of the dissertation in short preliminary papers ('kleine Abhandlungen'). Readers are presupposed to know the first of these, and he hopes reading them will make the whole accessible.
(4) He describes the second paper. The legible fragments mention algebraic differentials and 'die Grundlage für ...'. This matches the structure of the 1857 publication in Crelle 54, which is preceded by these preliminary sections:
  - 'Allgemeine Voraussetzungen und Hülfsmittel für die Untersuchung von Functionen unbeschränkt veränderlicher Größen';
  - 'Lehrsätze aus der analysis situs für die Theorie der Integrale von zweigliedrigen vollständigen Differentialien';
  - 'Bestimmung einer Function einer veränderlichen complexen Größe durch Grenz- und Unstetigkeitsbedingungen'.
(5) He closes, on the following page, by mentioning his connected lectures on Abelian functions of 1855–56 and asking for prompt printing.

The mathematical material on the neighbouring pages is not on this page. The previous page treats canonical cross-cuts a_mu, b_mu, c_mu of a (2p+1)-fold connected surface. The next page has a constant count 2m'-p+1 related to Riemann–Roch.

results.what: Draft covering letter to the editor of Crelle's Journal (Borchardt) about publishing Riemann's papers on Abelian functions. It explains that tools from his 1851 dissertation were reworked into short preliminary papers.
results.modern_name: Biographical/editorial correspondence concerning Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a non-mathematical letter draft. Its content (the publication history of the 1857 Abelian functions paper, its preliminary papers drawing on the 1851 dissertation, and the 1855/56 lectures) is well documented. It is of minor biographical interest only.
transcription_corrections: 'Herr Weissenborn[?]' (several occurrences) is very probably a misreading of the honorific '(Ew.) Wohlgeboren'. The addressee is the editor of Crelle's Journal (Borchardt), cf. 'Euer Wohlgeboren' on the next page.
'durch das Crelle'sche Journal gestatten worden' should read roughly '... gestatten wollen'.
'Herr Weissenborn und die übrigen Leser in diesem Gebiete' is more plausibly 'Ew. Wohlgeboren und die übrigen Leser ...'.
The ruled table headings 'No., Auslage, Porto, Franko' (with M/Pf subcolumns) belong to a printed form that Riemann reused as scrap paper. They are not part of the text.
